title.text: Mark Zuckerberg On The Future of AI, His Programming Days, and Orion AR

runs.text: Mark Zuckerberg On The Future of AI, His Programming Days, and Orion AR

accessibility_data.label: Mark Zuckerberg On The Future of AI, His Programming Days, and Orion AR 12 minutes, 8 seconds

description.text:
I had a conversation with Mark Zuckerberg about the future of AI and the importance of open-source development. We also dove into topics like what programming language he would use to build Facebook today if he had to do it all over again. The answer he gave was the one I was hoping for too!

Leading up to the conversation, I'm not going to lie, I was pretty nervous. Zuck is one of the most influential people in the world. I wanted to ensure this conversation felt organic and like you were in the room with us. I hope that by watching this conversation, you leave feeling as inspired as I did—to build more, take chances, but stay true to your mission.

0:45 BIG announcements from Meta Connect
1:57 Orion the first full holographic AR glasses 
2:41 What programming language would you choose to build Facebook in today
3:43 Mark Zuckerberg on his early days at college 
4:15 The importance of experimenting and building new things
4:31 Mark Zuckerberg on the importance on open source AI 
5:52 What are some of the coolest projects built on Llama
6:52 Orion AR glasses build process 
8:23 Could Orion glasses replace our phones
10:25 What does Mark Zuckerberg want to be remembered for and Meta to be remembered for?
